title: Schnellbild: an image & video viewer for macOS that just doesn't suck
seoTitle: Schnellbild · Free Image Viewer & MKV Player for Mac
seoDescription: Fast, free image viewer and video player for Mac: thumbnails, slideshow, MKV, AVI, WebM, ZIP and RAR as folders. A Phiewer, XnView and IrfanView alternative.

tagline: An image & video viewer for macOS that just doesn't suck.
lead: One free app for the pictures and videos in your folders. Open a folder, see thumbnails, look at one picture large, page through with the keyboard. Videos play right there, too, even MKV, AVI and WebM. No library to import into, no waiting.
fineprint: Both versions are the same app with every feature; whoever buys it in the Store supports its development. Thank you! 🖤

why: No ads, no tracking, no account
It shows your pictures and talks to nobody.
No pro version, no subscription, no "unlock" button. Every feature is in.
No library to import into, no editor, no cloud.
Thumbnails appear while you scroll, big folders and network shares included.
Pictures, videos and archives from others run nothing and go online nowhere, with nothing to switch on first.
Broken files, odd formats and slow disks show a placeholder, and the app keeps running.
demoLabel: Video: a photo opened from the grid, the trip's photos on the map and the globe, then the tour played
featuresMore: And many more features: every last detail is on GitHub

features.title: Look at it large, page with the keys
features.text:
Space opens a picture as large as the window allows, ← → page through the folder. Zoom in with the trackpad or + −, turn with ⌥← ⌥→, full screen with f. Animated GIFs and SVG included, PDFs page by page.

A slideshow (s) runs through the folder and all its subfolders, photos and videos alike. Whatever the slideshow plays is the playlist: p opens it to reorder and weed out.
features.alt: A photo in the full view

features.title: Your photos on the map and the globe
features.text:
W shows the photos and videos of a folder and its subfolders where they were taken. Zoomed far out, the map is a globe in front of the stars, with day and night if you like and the cities lit on its night side; zoom in and it flattens into the map.

  • The timeline lays the trip out by time: drag across it, and the map shows only that part
  • T plays the tour: the map glides from place to place, the photos show large, the videos play a few seconds
  • The map is inside the app: nothing goes online, no location leaves your Mac
features.alt: The photos of a trip on the globe, in the Atlas view

features.title: Videos, also the ones macOS can't play
features.text:
What macOS plays itself (MP4, MOV, AVCHD …) plays through macOS, HDR included; everything else through the VLC engine built in: MKV, WebM, AVI, WMV, FLV, MPEG, DVD video.

  • ← → jump a tenth of the video, ⇧← ⇧→ a hundredth
  • ↑ ↓ set the volume, for every video
  • ⌘→ to the next video and ⌘← back: the first goes on where it was left
  • Subtitles inside the video (V) show from the start; switched on halfway, the line already running appears at once, and ASS subtitles keep their position, colours and fonts
  • Finder and Quick Look get thumbnails for MKV, WebM, WMV, FLV and VOB too

features.title: Archives open like folders
features.text: ZIP, RAR and 7z, comics (CBZ, CBR) included, also in several parts; ZIP and RAR also with a password. Nothing is unpacked to disk, and videos play straight from the archive.
features.alt: Archives shown as folders with previews

features.title: Sort your holiday photos like in Norton Commander
features.text:
D shows two folders side by side. Mark pictures, then F5 copies and F6 moves them to the other side, or drag them there.

Rename, new folder, trash, bookmarks, and undo for renaming, trashing, copying and moving.
features.alt: Two folders side by side in the dual pane

features.title: Search through every subfolder
features.text: The search field matches the names of folders, archives, pictures and videos, in the folder shown and everything below it. Results arrive while it searches, a slow network share included. Ignoring case, matching it, or a regular expression.
features.alt: Search results from the folder and its subfolders

features.title: Better pictures, files untouched
features.text: E improves exposure, contrast, saturation and sharpness automatically, for photos and videos alike. A opens the sliders. It is a view: your files stay as they are.
features.alt: The adjustment sliders over a photo

features.title: What the file really is
features.text:
I or ⌘I opens the file info beside the picture: when and where it was taken, with a small map and the town nearby, camera and lens, format, resolution, codecs, bitrate, bit depth and colour profile, and every metadata key (EXIF, GPS, IPTC, XMP, QuickTime) to filter and copy. Times and places also come from XMP sidecars, a GoPro's or DJI drone's GPS data, Sony's clip files and GPX tracks in the folder.

A file whose extension doesn't match its content gets a note. Files whose name says nothing count by their content, and downloads still in progress (.part, .crdownload …) show as far as they have arrived.
features.alt: The file info next to a photo

features.title: Every key at hand
features.text: F1 lists every key, to print too; K shows a small keyboard to click. Set your own keys, or pick the keys as in Phiewer. Grid or list (L), sort by name, kind, date, size or distance from a place, several windows, and a boss key (X).

features.title: Light or dark, your choice
features.text: Some swear by dark mode, others can't stand it. So you decide: Same as System, Light or Dark, in Settings (⌘,).
features.alt: Settings: appearance as the system, light or dark

safeIntro: Pictures, videos and archives from strangers are exactly what a viewer is for, so Schnellbild treats every file as hostile, out of the box.
safe: No network at all, starts no programs by itself, sees only the folders you open to it plus Pictures.
Looking at something never changes it and never unpacks it to disk.
A "video" that is really a playlist pointing to the internet plays nothing.
Double click opens documents, not programs.
Apps, scripts and installers never, even when they hide behind a picture's name.
Provably built from the public source.
GitHub signs where every download comes from: the commit and the build. Anyone can check it.
safeMore: What it does in detail, and where its limit is: Safe with files from others.
modelsTitle: Coming from Phiewer, IINA or Norton Commander?
modelsText: Phiewer is a fast photo viewer with a paid PRO version, IINA a full player for watching videos; both were models for Schnellbild, as was Norton Commander for the dual pane. Schnellbild puts the pictures and videos in your folders into one free app, with the keys as in Phiewer if you like. How Schnellbild compares: a free Phiewer alternative, a free IINA alternative for looking through videos, from Norton Commander to the Mac.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: Schnellbild collects no personal data: no account, no analytics, no tracking, no network access.
privacy.intro: Schnellbild is an image and video viewer for macOS. Responsible for it (the controller under the GDPR) is HAUS HOPPE - ITS, Johannes Hoppe; the full address is in the imprint. This policy covers the app, as downloaded from GitHub and as bought in the Mac App Store (both are the same app), and this website.
privacy.appText:
Schnellbild collects no personal data. It has no account, no analytics, no advertising and no tracking, and it doesn't connect to the internet: the App Sandbox it runs in gives it no network access at all.

What stays on your Mac, and only there:
stays: Settings (the last folder, sort order, bookmarks, volume …) in the app's own preferences.
Folder access: the folders you opened to Schnellbild, as macOS bookmarks, so it can show them again after a restart. Settings → {folderAccess} forgets them.
Archive passwords you typed, in your login keychain (entry "Schnellbild archive passwords"); Settings → {forgetPasswords} removes them.

Your location, only when you click Use My Location while sorting by distance: macOS asks you first, the position is asked for once and kept only as the place to measure distances from, in the app's preferences. It never leaves your Mac.
privacy.appOutro: Schnellbild reads your pictures, videos and archives only to show them to you. It never sends them, their names or anything about them anywhere. Apple handles the download and purchase under its own privacy policy and gives us only figures without your identity: sales, and crash reports and usage statistics if you allowed sharing them with app developers in macOS.
privacy.siteText: This website uses no cookies, no analytics and no content from other servers (no web fonts, no embedded videos). It is hosted on GitHub Pages, a service of GitHub, Inc. (USA). When you visit it, GitHub logs and stores your IP address for security purposes; see GitHub Pages: data collection and the GitHub privacy statement. How long GitHub keeps these logs is up to GitHub; we have no access to them. GitHub takes part in the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, for which the European Commission decided that the USA ensures an adequate level of protection (Art. 45 GDPR). The legal basis is our legitimate interest in delivering the website securely (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). The download of the app comes from GitHub as well. If you pick light or dark with the switch at the top, your browser keeps that choice (localStorage); it stays on your device and reaches no one.
privacy.rightsText: Under the GDPR you have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing and data portability, and the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority. You have the right to object, on grounds relating to your particular situation, to processing based on our legitimate interest (Art. 21 GDPR). Since neither the app nor this website keeps personal data of its own, there is nothing on our side to look up or delete. A request for access will therefore get a short answer: we know nothing about you.
privacy.contactText: For everything about Schnellbild (questions, ideas, bugs, and requests about your data too), please contact us through GitHub: open an issue at github.com/JohannesHoppe/schnellbild/issues. That's where we answer fastest, and others can read the answer too. An issue is public; for anything you'd rather not discuss in public, the imprint lists other ways to reach us.
